its graph follows the note in front (needs Dataview on, as in Obsidian); phone: no split to show it beside the note
board opens in the note's tab; moving a card writes the Markdown
Preview opens beside the note and draws it; on a phone there's no split, so it covers the note and shows nothing
mindmap-plugin notes open as its mind map. Shares the frontmatter key with Enhancing Mindmap: only one should be on
mindmap-plugin notes open as an editable mind map
Extends Obsidian's own canvas view (internals); Vaultite's canvas isn't Obsidian's. Loads, its commands are there
Its navigator lists the vault, opens notes and folder spaces. Its inline context in the editor needs Obsidian's .cm-sizer (absent)

a note with annotation-target opens its viewer: the PDF in pdf.js with Hypothesis's sidebar, an annotation or page note saved into the note as Annotator writes it; the viewer keeps its page when its tab is left and come back to. Phone not tried
Extends Obsidian's PDF viewer (internals); Vaultite draws PDFs itself. Loads without breaking anything
Desktop only. Loads; its main daemon is an Electron helper installed into Obsidian's app folder, so its setup modal shows each start and playback features that need it don't run. Not checked further
Pasted image converted to webp and linked (editor-paste). On a phone the app's own paste handled it (not traced)
Desktop only. Its first start downloads reveal.js (a zip, through GitHub's redirect) into its folder; the preview pane beside the note shows the deck from its local server and follows edits
A frame opens as its pane: Electron's <webview> is an iframe here (sites refusing frames show nothing)

Thino: onboarding, its view and capture work (a memo goes into today's daily note as `- HH:mm text`, the box clears, the app's font); its list shows only the newest memo's text, older ones their time alone (closed source, its list's own rendering)
its new diagram file is made (.svg) but its editor doesn't open: it opens it in the note's own leaf, which compat keeps for the note (opening the .svg from the tree shows the app's picture)
